_about: Aniline (1) + N,N-Dimethylformamide (2): isobaric T-x-y at 96.15 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of aniline, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of aniline, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Mali, N. A.[Nilesh A.], Mali, P. K.[Pawan K.], Patil, A. P.[Asmita P.], Joshi, S. S.[Sunil S.], Vapor Liquid Equilibrium Data for Binary Mixtures of Acetic Acid + Anisole, Acetone + Anisole, and Isopropanol + Anisole at Pressure 96.15 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 947-953
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 13, 14. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0062. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.51 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
